## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: driver condition and occupant protection
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The alcohol-fatality share and drowsy-driving claims are statistics the handbook attributes to the National Sleep Foundation and NHTSA; they are stated as the handbook gives them, not as independently checked figures [A03].
The handbook says drowsy driving causes thousands of crashes each year without a figure; no number was supplied for it [A01].
Legal rules (texting ban, under-18 phone ban, school bus phone ban, seat belt law, child restraint thresholds, helmet law, pickup bed rule) are kept apart from safety advice in the facts [A02].
The pickup-bed statute's exemptions are mentioned but not listed in the handbook, so none are named in the dossier.
The Highway Safety Research Center contact address was not reproduced; contact details can change.

corpus_stability.reason: The handbook prints a single revision date (Revised May 2025) on its back cover and states laws and fees are subject to change by the General Assembly; no sign of more than one revision per year in the selected pages.
